api_version.sh: Version of the callback output format.

content.sh: Custom content that must contain placeholder [%code%]
RCS message content in RCS JSON format.

allow_duplicates.sh: When parameter allow_duplicates is set to "1" allows to send message to duplicated numbers in one request (useful i.e.

check_idx.sh: When parameter check_idx is set to „1” prevents from sending more than one message with the same idx in last 24h.

date.sh: Date in UNIX timestamp (&date=1287734110) or in ISO 8601 (&date=2012-05-10T08:40:27+00:00) when message will be sent (&date=1287734110).

date_validate.sh: When parameter date_validate is set to "1" checks if date if given in proper format.

details.sh: When details parameter is set to "1" more details in response will be displayed (message length and sms count).

encoding.sh: This parameter describes the encoding of the message text.

expiration_date.sh: Message expiration date (in UNIX timestamp or in ISO 8601) is a date after which message won't be delivered if it wasn't delivered yet.

fallback.sh: Enable fallback in case sms sending fails

fast.sh: Setting this parameter to „1” will result in sending message with the highest priority which ensures the quickest possible time of delivery.

flash.sh: Sending a message in flash mode can be activated by setting this parameter to "1".

format.sh: Parameter &format=json causes, that response is sending in JSON format.

group.sh: Name of the group from the contacts database to which message should be sent to.

idx.sh: Optional custom value sent with SMS and sent back in CALLBACK.

max_parts.sh: Defines maximum message parts allowed, maximum value allowed is 6.

normalize.sh: When parameter normalize is set to „1” special chars in message will be replaced with their equivalents (ê-e, ñ-n, ý-y ...).

notify_url.sh: Parameter allows to set CALLBACK URL for message from request.

test.sh: When parameter test is set to "1" message won't be sent but response will be displayed, there is no charge for such test messages.

time_restriction.sh: Sets the behavior when you try to ship in hours / dates that do not match the settings in your account.

interface.sh: Interface through which the message was sent (www, api, ...).

info.about_md:
**Unofficial. Not affiliated with SMSAPI.** This is an unofficial SDK for the SMSAPI public API, built by [Voxgig](https://voxgig.com/sdk). It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by SMSAPI or LINK Mobility.

SMSAPI already publishes official client libraries for PHP, C#, Python, JavaScript, Java, Go and Bash, and they remain the place to start for those languages. This repository is about the surface those libraries do not cover: an MCP server, so AI agents such as Claude and Cursor can look up contacts, groups, templates, sender names, callbacks, opt-outs and account data in SMSAPI, and a command-line tool with an interactive REPL. The generated MCP server is read-only, with list and load tools, and the CLI covers list, load and update; sending a message goes through the SDKs.

Because every surface here is generated from SMSAPI's own OpenAPI documents, none of them drift from the API. Hand-written agent integrations usually fall behind on the first release; this one is regenerated instead.

The same generator also emits clients in further languages, included here as a reference.

### Honest state

Generated from SMSAPI's public OpenAPI documents (the Panel and Contacts specifications behind smsapi.com/rest) on 2026-10-01. Not production-tuned. Known rough edge: entity names are derived from the paths, and a few resources come out split in two. Contact groups are Group (load, update) and Contactsgroup (create, list, remove, members, permissions); sender names and SMS templates have the same split, and sending an SMS is the create operation of an entity named Smsdo, after the /sms.do path. Every operation is present; the grouping is not yet tidy. Use it as a starting point or a reference.

When teams want SDKs and agent surfaces like these production-grade, tested and released through a real pipeline, Voxgig does that work as a consulting engagement. Questions: richard@voxgig.com.

If you are from SMSAPI and would like this repository removed, or transferred to your own GitHub organisation, email richard@voxgig.com and it will be done within two business days, no questions asked.

### URL adresses
API URL adresses:
* `https://api.smsapi.com/` - for secure SSL connections
* `https://api2.smsapi.com/` - backup for secure SSL connections

### Authorization
Authorization at SMSAPI utilizes OAuth 2 mechanism.
You can generate OAuth token in our customer panel [API Tokens](https://ssl.smsapi.com/react/oauth/manage).
Authorization header will be necessary in request to our API.

`Authorization: Bearer <token>`
